plan.disposition: medium+ only gate (external LLM plan review); this run classified small

findings.finding: Suppression is TASK-scoped and permanent, not question-scoped — once a task's poFeedback is set or its lq-<taskId> id is dismissed, that task can never surface another lead_question until leadwright clears poFeedback and rewrites description. FIXED: documented as an explicit by-design contract in _lead.ts's header comment.
findings.suggestion: State the cross-repo contract explicitly so the next reader does not read the current behavior as a bug.

findings.finding: The answer PATCH's failure modes were silent and reachable (server 400s over 6000 chars, 409s on lockfile contention, no client-side cap, no error surface). FIXED: added an answerMutation.isError alert and a maxLength cap on the textarea.
findings.suggestion: Render an isError alert and cap the textarea's maxLength to the server's DESCRIPTION_MAX_LENGTH minus the timestamp marker's length.

findings.finding: The question body rendered unclipped, unlike both sibling cards, letting one lead card dominate the Inbox list. FIXED: reused the same MAX_BODY_PREVIEW_PX + fade wrapper as InboxCard.Waiting.tsx.
findings.suggestion: Reuse the sibling cards' clip + fade wrapper.

findings.finding: The exhaustiveness test was tautological — it asserted a standalone never-check with no reference to InboxCard.tsx's actual guard. FIXED: rewrote to call the real exported unhandledInboxItemKind guard inside a type-only, never-invoked function so a widened parameter type fails to compile.
findings.suggestion: Assert against the real exported guard, not a standalone type check.

findings.finding: The FR-04.37 outbound client test was vacuous — it fed already-stripped input and asserted no marker in the output, proving nothing about stripping. FIXED: removed, with a pointer to the real server-side coverage in _lead.test.ts's extractLeadQuestionBody cases.
findings.suggestion: Delete the vacuous assertion; the real coverage is server-side.

findings.finding: The Inbox-fence carve-out was broader than documented — the file exclusion covered all three scans (input/textarea/contentEditable) and matched on basename rather than exact path. FIXED: narrowed to only the textarea scan, matched on the exact relative path.
findings.suggestion: Scope the exclusion to only the textarea scan and match the exact relative path.

findings.finding: InboxItemBase/InboxItemCommon were collapsed onto single lines to stay under the bloat ceiling, buying headroom by compression rather than extraction. FIXED: extracted the whole InboxItem union into a new client/src/lib/inboxItemTypes.ts file, re-exported from externalApi.ts for back-compat, restoring normal multi-line style and real headroom.
findings.suggestion: Extract the type family into its own file instead of compressing it.

findings.finding: Marker stripping only handled the leading marker and LF-only newlines — a second marker line further down, or a CRLF-terminated marker, could leave sentinel text or a stray \r in the body. FIXED: generalized the strip to also remove any marker-only line anywhere in the body, and to handle CRLF.
findings.suggestion: Strip all marker-only lines and handle CRLF explicitly.

findings.finding: Three new production modules (_lead.ts, leadQuestionApi.ts, InboxCard.LeadQuestion.tsx) shipped without a corresponding entry in REQUIRED_TOKENS, contrary to the file's own stated contract. FIXED: added the tokens plus matching architecture.md prose and an Updates-list bullet.
findings.suggestion: Extend REQUIRED_TOKENS and the doc bundle in the same commit as new production modules.

findings.finding: No changelog drop yet for a user-visible feature (a new Inbox card kind with an answer form).
findings.suggestion: Add a changelog drop as part of F4 finalization.

findings.finding: A repeat dismiss of an already-dismissed lead_question falls through to 404 rather than an idempotent 200 — harmless and consistent with how the three existing kinds behave. NOT FIXED: matches existing sibling-kind behavior, not a regression introduced by this change.
findings.suggestion: Optional: return 200 idempotently when the id is already dismissed (left as-is, out of scope).

findings.finding: The lq- id convention was spelled literally instead of reusing inboxItemKey(). FIXED: now calls inboxItemKey(item).

doubt.disposition: small complexity, no migrations/async-concurrency/cross-plugin-imports/irreversible-ops touched — Stage-3 doubt-reviewer gate does not apply
